values.en: The coordinate maps $w\mapsto(a,b)$ and $z\mapsto(c,d)$ are linear because $U,V$ are a basis. The polynomial $eac+f(ad+bc)+gbd$ is linear in each pair and invariant under exchanging them. Componentwise equality of mixed partials on the open $C^2$ domain gives $\langle X_{uv},\boldsymbol N\rangle=\langle X_{vu},\boldsymbol N\rangle$, so this symmetric coefficient matrix is the matrix of all second partial normal components.
values.zh-CN: 由于 $U,V$ 是基，坐标映射 $w\mapsto(a,b)$、$z\mapsto(c,d)$ 线性。多项式 $eac+f(ad+bc)+gbd$ 对每一对坐标分别线性，交换两对坐标不变。开集上 $C^2$ 映射逐分量满足混合偏导相等，故 $\langle X_{uv},\boldsymbol N\rangle=\langle X_{vu},\boldsymbol N\rangle$，这个对称系数矩阵确为全部二阶偏导法分量的矩阵。
